subtitle: 把学习工具启动起来，再逐项检查它真的可用

exercises.title: 配置分层：缺失、来源与凭据

question.zh-CN: 不调用模型：同一份配置先预测再由真实子进程回报；缺必填项和配置文件里放凭据，都应该在启动前被拒绝。
question.en: No model call: the same configuration is predicted and then reported by a real child process; missing required settings and a credential in the settings file must both be refused before the start.

exercises.title: 启动、就绪与停止：卡住、占用与孤儿进程

question.zh-CN: 不调用模型：真实启动子进程，分别探测存活和就绪，再让它卡住、不就绪、端口被占用，最后比较两种停止方式留下的进程。
question.en: No model call: really start the child process and probe liveness and readiness separately, then make it hang, stay unready and meet a busy port, and compare the processes left by two ways of stopping.

exercises.title: 结构化日志与凭据泄漏

question.zh-CN: 不调用模型：读回一次正常运行的日志，再读回一个把整份配置写进日志的版本，看扫描能不能拦下泄漏。
question.en: No model call: read back the log of a normal run, then the log of a version that writes its whole configuration into the log, and see whether the scan stops the leak.

exercises.title: 崩溃重启、重发写入与配置回退

question.zh-CN: 不调用模型：写入后整组杀掉再重启，重发一次写入；再换上读不了的新配置，备份回退后看服务和数据。
question.en: No model call: write, kill the whole group and restart, repeat one write; then switch to a new settings file it cannot read, and see the service and the data after the backup is put back.

ui.question_help: 四个练习都由结构化输入决定；这里的文字只作备注，不会传给服务，也不会改变任何检查。
